P01-A.content: {"suggestions":[{"requirement":"R1","text":"Hold a Class 3 driving licence issued by the Traffic Police (2020)."},{"requirement":"R2","text":"Four years of logistics experience, including dispatch coordination and cold-store warehouse operations, managing daily delivery schedules and inventory."},{"requirement":"R4","text":"Completed a Basic Workplace Safety Orientation Course (2021) and have hands‑on experience with cold‑room safety protocols."},{"requirement":"R5","text":"Demonstrated teamwork and communication skills through coordinating with drivers, customers, and warehouse staff, and participating in safety briefings."}],"gaps":["R3"]}

P04-A.content: {"suggestions":[{"requirement":"R1","text":"Over 2 years of warehouse and inventory operations experience, including receiving, put-away, order picking, and weekly stock counts for a cold room of 400 pallets."},{"requirement":"R2","text":"Proficient in Excel, with experience maintaining and updating shared Excel dispatch logs and performing basic sorting, filtering, and calculations."},{"requirement":"R4","text":"Class 3 driving licence, enabling coordination with drivers and support for day‑shift logistics operations."},{"requirement":"R5","text":"Consistently maintained accurate inventory records and reduced errors through weekly stock counts and adherence to cold room safety rules."},{"requirement":"R6","text":"Coordinated with drivers and customers via WhatsApp and shared Excel sheets to manage delivery schedules and resolve delays."}],"gaps":["R3"]}

P05-A.content: {"suggestions":[{"requirement":"R1","text":"Demonstrated customer-facing experience as a Dispatch Coordinator, liaising with drivers and customers to resolve delivery delays and provide timely updates."},{"requirement":"R2","text":"Managed communication with customers via WhatsApp and maintained an up-to-date dispatch log, showcasing ability to handle enquiries through digital channels."},{"requirement":"R4","text":"Fluent in English and conversational in Mandarin, enabling effective communication with a diverse customer base."},{"requirement":"R5","text":"While the current roles did not involve cash handling, the candidate has experience coordinating daily delivery operations and maintaining accurate logs, indicating strong attention to detail and reliability."}],"gaps":["R3"]}

P05-B.content: {"suggestions":[{"requirement":"R1","text":"Demonstrated 1.5 years of customer-facing experience as a Retail Sales Assistant at Orchard Row Stationers, handling customer inquiries, operating the POS, and providing service to a diverse clientele."},{"requirement":"R2","text":"Handled daily phone calls and appointment bookings at Bukit Lane Dental Clinic, showcasing proficiency in managing customer enquiries via phone and scheduling systems."},{"requirement":"R4","text":"Fluent in English and Tamil, with basic Mandarin proficiency, enabling effective communication with a broad customer base."},{"requirement":"R5","text":"Balanced the till at the end of each shift as a Retail Sales Assistant, ensuring accurate cash handling and transaction reconciliation."}],"gaps":["R3"]}
